issue.title: [BUG] Il server non si connette
issue.body: Claude Desktop mostra 'MCP server disconnected' ogni volta che avvio il client su Windows 11.

comments.body: Details: ha-mcp 8.4.3, HACS integration inside Home Assistant 2026.9.1; Windows 11; Claude Desktop 1.0.0. Direct HTTP connection, no stdio or bridge. Repro: launch Claude Desktop, enable the existing ha-mcp connector, then call ha_config_get_dashboard with url_path='lovelace'. The client reports 'MCP server disconnected' and the dashboard is not returned. Expected: dashboard configuration returned. Reproduces every time.
